purpose: Sufficiency test: a diagnostic, not a method contribution. No score here is a performance result.
framing_constraint: never describe a resulting R2 as a performance win, never place it in a table against UrbanMoE, never count it toward the 0.80 bar. The finding is that the only feature closing the gap is the label's own source, which no image can contain.

preregistration.P-B1: odiacpoint lifts Beijing carbon >= +0.10 paired and does NOT lift Shanghai (< +0.02); falsified if Shanghai gains >= +0.10 or Beijing gains < +0.10
preregistration.P-B2: plants gains less than odiacpoint on Beijing carbon (vintage trap); falsified if plants >= odiacpoint there
preregistration.P-B3: New York gains from odiacpoint but less than Beijing; falsified if New York's gain exceeds Beijing's

block_placement: both blocks join the POI block, as the osmv2 layers do, so the architecture and ladder are unchanged and block scaling by sqrt(width) is inherited from the probe

plants.dist_km_nearest_fossil50: the plant-proximity statistic itself, encoded directly
plants.log1p_invdist_capacity: sum of capacity_mw / (distance_km + 1); ODIAC's point term is emissions-weighted and capacity is the public proxy for emissions
plants.log1p_count_2km: sources within roughly one tile width, where the oracle ceiling concentrates (92% of Beijing's error within 2 km)
plants.log1p_count_10km: the radius the plant cross-check reports its fractions at
plants.log1p_max_capacity_5km: a tile's point term is dominated by its single largest plant, not by how many plants are nearby
plants.log1p_capacity_sum_5km: the extensive companion to the max, since adjacent units at one site are listed as separate plants

odiacpoint.log1p_point_tonneC_in_tile: the label's own injected mass inside the tile, area-weighted with the same rule as the rest of the forensics
odiacpoint.dist_km_nearest_point_cell: distance to the nearest detected source, so tiles just outside one are distinguishable from tiles far from any
odiacpoint.log1p_point_tonneC_within_5km: nearby injected mass; ODIAC's plant geolocation has documented error (Oda and Maksyutov 2011) so the exact cell may be offset from the true site
